Understand, evaluate, and ethically navigate the world of AI-generated images.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — comprehensive guide for understanding, identifying, and ethically navigating AI-generated images.

- Explains how AI image generation works (diffusion models, training data, text-to-image basics) in clear, accessible language.
- Teaches common indicators for recognizing AI-generated images, with emphasis on education over detection guarantees.
- Covers ethical and legal considerations, including transparency, style mimicry, copyright, consent, and misinformation risks.
- Offers practical guidelines tailored to different user roles: consumers, creators, educators, and professionals.
- Does not generate images, analyze legality, or provide legal advice; strictly educational and safety-compliant.
- Includes relatable examples for parents and creators navigating the AI image landscape.
